result.question: What two things did Jehoiada do with the commanders before showing them the king’s son?

readings.answer: Made a covenant with them and put them under oath
readings.support: made a covenant with them and put them under oath

readings.answer: Sent for them and had them brought into the house of the LORD
readings.support: sent for the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, and the guards, and had them brought into the house of the LORD

assessments.reason: The passage says, “There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath. He showed them the king’s son,” which exactly matches the two actions asked for before the showing.

The question asks what Jehoiada did “with the commanders,” which the text mirrors as “made a covenant with them” and “put them under oath”; “sent for them and had them brought” are actions done to them earlier, not actions done with them immediately before the showing.

result.reason: The verse explicitly lists the two actions—made a covenant with them and put them under oath—immediately before he showed them the king’s son.
